tools.name: search-user-scopes
tools.description: Finds consent scopes available for one registered user. Use this before request-consent to choose the narrowest scope. Returns only scope strings and pagination state.

user_identifier.title: User identifier
user_identifier.description: Registered email address, phone number, or Hussh account identifier. Hussh resolves it internally and never returns it.

query.title: Scope search text
query.description: Optional search text. Leave empty to list all scopes.

domain.title: Scope domain
domain.description: Optional lower-case domain filter such as financial.

cursor.title: Pagination cursor
cursor.description: Optional cursor returned by the previous search-user-scopes call.

limit.title: Result limit
limit.description: Maximum number of scopes to return, from 1 through 50.

country_iso2.title: Country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
country_iso2.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code used for phone resolution.

country.title: Country name
country.description: Optional country name used for phone resolution when country_iso2 is absent.

tools.name: prepare-campaign-context
tools.description: Prepares a least-privilege consent-backed offer or experience context for one user. It selects an available scope, creates or reuses consent, and returns safe lifecycle state for an agent or frontend.

user_identifier.title: User identifier
user_identifier.description: Registered email address, phone number, or Hussh account identifier. Hussh resolves it internally and never returns it.

campaign_goal.title: Offer goal
campaign_goal.description: Plain-language goal for the offer or experience.

purpose.title: Consent purpose
purpose.description: Plain-language purpose displayed to the user for this consent request.

surface.title: Experience surface
surface.description: Optional experience surface using this context.

preferred_context.title: Preferred context
preferred_context.description: Optional scope preference. Use auto to let Hussh select the least-privilege match.

expiry_hours.title: Expiry hours
expiry_hours.description: How long an approved grant remains valid, from 24 through 2160 hours.

approval_timeout_minutes.title: Approval timeout minutes
approval_timeout_minutes.description: How long Hussh waits for approval, from 5 through 1440 minutes.

refresh_policy.title: Grant refresh policy
refresh_policy.description: Use snapshot for one export or continuous_until_expiry for approved refreshes.

poll_seconds.title: Offer polling window seconds
poll_seconds.description: Optional bounded in-call wait for lifecycle state, from 0 through 90 seconds.

fetch_export_metadata.title: Fetch export metadata
fetch_export_metadata.description: Whether to report encrypted-export readiness after an already granted request.

offer_amount.title: Offer amount
offer_amount.description: Optional amount offered for the approved consent. This records an offer; it does not settle payment.

offer_currency.title: Offer currency
offer_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 offer currency such as USD.

offer_summary.title: Offer summary
offer_summary.description: Optional user-facing summary of the offer.

settlement_ref.title: Settlement reference
settlement_ref.description: Optional opaque settlement reference owned by the caller.

country_iso2.title: Country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
country_iso2.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code used for phone resolution.

country.title: Country name
country.description: Optional country name used for phone resolution when country_iso2 is absent.

tools.name: request-consent
tools.description: Creates or reuses a least-privilege consent request for one user. Use after search-user-scopes. The user must approve before retrieval or decryption. A trusted connector should securely retain its private export key outside model context so authorized realtime export revisions remain decryptable.

user_identifier.title: User identifier
user_identifier.description: Registered email address, phone number, or Hussh account identifier. Hussh resolves it internally and never returns it.

scope.title: Consent scope
scope.description: Least-privilege scope returned by search-user-scopes. Preserve the value exactly when requesting consent.

purpose.title: Consent purpose
purpose.description: Plain-language purpose displayed to the user for this consent request.

expiry_hours.title: Expiry hours
expiry_hours.description: How long an approved grant remains valid, from 24 through 2160 hours.

approval_timeout_minutes.title: Approval timeout minutes
approval_timeout_minutes.description: How long Hussh waits for user approval, from 5 through 1440 minutes.

refresh_policy.title: Grant refresh policy
refresh_policy.description: Use snapshot for one export or continuous_until_expiry for approved refreshes.

connector_public_key.title: Connector public key
connector_public_key.description: Optional connector X25519 public key. An unregistered connector supplies the complete key bundle per request; a registered app may omit it or must supply the exact registered value.

connector_key_id.title: Connector key identifier
connector_key_id.description: Optional connector key identifier. Supply it with the public key and wrapping algorithm for an unregistered connector; a registered app may omit it or must supply the exact registered value.

connector_wrapping_alg.title: Connector wrapping algorithm
connector_wrapping_alg.description: Optional wrapping algorithm. It must be X25519-AES256-GCM and is supplied with an unregistered connector key bundle; a registered app may omit it or must supply the exact registered value.

offer_amount.title: Offer amount
offer_amount.description: Optional amount offered for the approved consent. This records an offer; it does not settle payment.

offer_currency.title: Offer currency
offer_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 offer currency such as USD.

offer_summary.title: Offer summary
offer_summary.description: Optional user-facing summary of the offer.

settlement_ref.title: Settlement reference
settlement_ref.description: Optional opaque settlement reference owned by the caller.

country_iso2.title: Country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
country_iso2.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code used for phone resolution.

country.title: Country name
country.description: Optional country name used for phone resolution when country_iso2 is absent.

tools.name: check-consent-status
tools.description: Checks one consent request previously returned by request-consent. Poll no faster than poll_after_seconds and stop at a terminal state. Retrieval and connector-side decryption are allowed only when status is granted and grant_ref is present.

request_ref.title: Consent request reference
request_ref.description: Opaque request reference returned by request-consent.

tools.name: get-encrypted-scoped-export
tools.description: Secure connector delivery only: retrieves an approved export after check-consent-status returns status granted and a grant_ref. Local stdio decrypts in its trusted process; hosted connectors use the documented envelope-v2 method with their securely retained private key. Never display, remember, interpret, or decrypt key material or ciphertext in an LLM. Reuse the same connector key for authorized realtime export revisions until rotation or revocation.

grant_ref.title: Consent grant reference
grant_ref.description: Opaque approved-grant reference returned by request-consent or check-consent-status.

expected_scope.title: Expected scope
expected_scope.description: Least-privilege scope returned by search-user-scopes. Preserve the value exactly when requesting consent.
